stated_claims: Ceramic non-stick cookware sets without PTFE
Women 28-45 who care about what their cookware is made of

relevant_tags.why: Cookware is a core kitchen product.
Cookware falls under general home goods.
The product is PTFE-free and targets buyers who care about materials.
The explicitly stated target audience is women.

persona_conflicts.conflict: Disinterested in luxury-only messaging and premium positioning due to high price sensitivity.

note_signals.why: Hearthstone Goods sells cookware directly, creating a conflict of interest on their thank-you page.

Northbed buyers are design-conscious and show high cross-sell with home and wellness.

gate_reason: The product, price point, target audience, and core differentiators are clearly specified and actionable.
